biggest_cut: In Proposition 6, I would cut the long isolation argument (first-return sections, flow-box coverings of the compact orbit, and the two-directional nonisolated/isolated correspondence) down to a sentence saying that zeros of Δ correspond, via the smooth coordinate s = r + M_+(0,r), to fixed points of the Poincaré return map, so isolated zeros are exactly isolated cycles, together with Remark 7, which mostly restates it.
